# v0.9.0 — Python ecosystem

> **Status:** Ready on `main` (2026-06-13) — tag **v0.9.0** pending

## Highlights

- **`Ontology` / `OntologyBuilder`:** in-memory construction from JSON v2 dict or fluent builder
- **`Reasoner`:** load from `path` or `ontology`; multi-pass `add_subclass_of` / `remove_subclass_of` / `add_axiom_json`
- **`explain()`:** proof graph dict (EL full traces; RL/RDFS asserted-only limits documented)
- **Export:** optional `subsumptions_to_pandas` / `subsumptions_to_polars` helpers
- **CI:** Pizza EL golden pytest; macOS Python job; corpora download before pytest

## Upgrade notes

Bump all `ontologos-*` crates together:

```toml
ontologos-core = "0.9.0"
ontologos-bridge = "0.9.0"
ontologos-parser = "0.9.0"
ontologos-profile = "0.9.0"
ontologos-rdfs = "0.9.0"
ontologos-rl = "0.9.0"
ontologos-el = "0.9.0"
ontologos-query = "0.9.0"
ontologos-explain = "0.9.0"
```

Python: `pip install ontologos==0.9.0`

New APIs:

```python
from ontologos import Ontology, OntologyBuilder, Reasoner, subsumptions_to_pandas

# Build in memory
builder = OntologyBuilder()
builder.add_class("http://example.org/A")
builder.add_class("http://example.org/B")
builder.subclass_of("http://example.org/A", "http://example.org/B")
reasoner = Reasoner(ontology=builder.build(), profile="el", incremental=True)
reasoner.classify()
reasoner.add_subclass_of("http://example.org/B", "http://example.org/C")
reasoner.classify()

# Explain
graph = reasoner.explain()
```

See [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md) and [docs/guides/python.md](../../docs/guides/python.md).
